title: Ruthless Loaded  Cotton Candy Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Cotton Candy by Ruthless captures the nostalgic delight of fresh, fairground-style Cotton Candy, delivering a light, sugary sweetness with a delicate caramelised finish. Soft, airy, and indulgently sweet, this e-liquid evokes the simple joy of spun sugar melting on the tongue, making for a smooth and endlessly satisfying, sweet vape. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Cotton Candy Pink features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense vapour production and a well-rounded flavour experience. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. Ruthless has been at the forefront of e-liquid innovation for over a decade, crafting bold and imaginative flavours that continue to define the industry. Their dedication to premium ingredients and expert blending ensures a standout vaping experience in every bottle.
